software_tests.scope: citation V1/V2, grammar, runner and scoring; not whole repository

decision_rule: Full explicit/generic JSON >=7/8 format-valid and zero bracket_only_mismatch is engineering readiness only, not efficacy.
candidate_reuse: Same label-free candidates as failed citation-interface-001 (one rejected HTTP request, zero model completions); no output-based selection or pooling.
integrity: No retries, truncation, output repair, effect-based stopping, imputation or changed seeds. Failed infrastructure calls block scoring.
public_sync: Local pre-inference commit only; GitHub authentication unresolved; not public preregistration.
